text:
sam: Heads-up — after the exports map tweak in @redwood-inference/sdk v1.7.0 our Cloudflare Workers sample app started throwing at import time: "Uncaught TypeError: Failed to resolve module specifier '.../dist/index.cjs.js'". repro steps: `wrangler dev` -> instant error.

maria: Ugh. Is the sample still importing `require('@redwood-inference/sdk')` anywhere? Workers are ESM-only.

sam: Sample uses `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood-inference/sdk'` but bundler resolves to the CJS fallback because of our exports map conditional order. Works in node (with dual entry) but Workers picks the wrong path.

alex: Can you paste the exports block? my guess is conditional ordering like {"node":..., "default": ...} caused the edge runtime to pick an unexpected entry.

sam: Here — from package.json in the SDK release:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js",
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
  }
}
```

kevin: That looks fine at first glance. But some edge bundlers prefer `default`/`browser`/unconditional and might resolve to the `require` path if they don't honor the `import` condition correctly. Also our auth-retry wrapper is only exported from the CJS entry (ugh).

maria: Wait — auth retry wrapper? Is that the runtime that patches fetch with retry middleware? Which symbol is missing?

kevin: `withAuthRetry` helper. We accidentally exported it only from the cjs build during the last refactor. SDK consumers on node used it fine; edge consumers now fail at runtime when they try to import it (even if generation works).

sam: Error log from Worker: `TypeError: undefined is not a function at handleRequest` — traced to `withAuthRetry`.

alex: CI also caught it — `ci-bot` attached a failing test run for the samples suite.

ci-bot: build/sample-apps · master #482 
- test: samples/edge-worker imports · failed
- log: "Error: Cannot read property 'withAuthRetry' of undefined"

maria: Two quick options: 1) patch the exports map so `import` is evaluated first by more runtimes (e.g., add an explicit `default` pointing to mjs), or 2) re-export `withAuthRetry` from the ESM build and cut a patch release.

kevin: Re-exporting from ESM seems safest. Also add a test that runs the sample bundling with esbuild/rollup for edge target so we don’t regress.

sam: I can open a PR to re-export and update the exports map. Also will update the sample to avoid `require` anywhere.

alex: Can we add an onboarding note in the README about how package exports interact with edge runtimes and bundlers (quick rules + troubleshooting)? This keeps new users from being bitten.

maria: Yes — short checklist: 
- prefer ESM imports in samples
- ensure `exports` has an explicit `default` or `import` entry that points to mjs
- include a minimal esbuild config for workers
- verify types are present at the ESM entrypoint

sam: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234 — includes re-export, tests, and README entry.

kevin: Also add a changelog note explaining that v1.7.0 changed exports and why users may need to pin or upgrade.

maria: For immediate mitigation, I rolled a quick patch to the samples repo to import from `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.mjs'` — ugly but buys time.

sam: Thanks. After the PR merges we should cut a 1.7.1 and publish. I'll also add a short section to the onboarding guide about the auth helper parity across builds — that was the surprising part for the support team.

alex: Minor follow-up — typing: consumers using `import type { RedwoodTypes } from '@redwood-inference/sdk'` got errors because the `types` pointer was not recognized by some TS setups; add `types` in the top-level exports mapping and mention `types` in the README.

maria: Good catch. Add "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" under the same subpath in exports.

kevin: Postmortem action items: SDK: re-export helper in ESM, add exports+types tests, update changelog. Samples: avoid implicit require paths, add worker esbuild example. Docs: onboarding note and troubleshooting.

sam: I'll link the PR in #support so support can triage incoming tickets.

maria: Cool — feel free to ping me for review. :thumbsup:

kevin: closing loop — once patch is published I'll update the Dedicated quickstart snippets too.

sam: thanks all — shipping patch now. :ship:
